events.title: ITT (NYSE:ITT) Beats Q1 CY2026 Sales Expectations
events.body: Engineered components manufacturer for critical industries ITT Inc. (NYSE: ITT) reported Q1 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 32.7% year on year to $1.21 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.98 per share

events.title: ITT (ITT) Q1 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
events.body: ITT (ITT) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +11.86% and +8.45%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: IAC (IAC) Reports Q1 Loss, Lags Revenue Estimates
events.body: IAC (IAC) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +85.15% and -17.85%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
